title: TOWARDS ETHICAL CONTENT-BASED DETECTION OF ONLINE INFLUENCE CAMPAIGNS

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the false positive classification rates of a BERT-based influence campaign detection model on English comments written by native (L1) Russian speakers versus native (L1) English speakers.

Evaluating the model's false positive rate on sentences containing frequent named entities (such as US political figures or locations) and using Named Entity Masking (NEM) to replace these entities with parts-of-speech tags to measure and mitigate spurious correlations.
